hardware.requirements: Switchless 0-1-2-3-0 cable cycle with the managed-mesh fabric plan applied: routes, neighbor tables and the hardware-offloaded tc-flower relay rule (EtherType 0x88b5) on every rail, as installed by the GLM-5.3 managed-mesh fabric service. The launcher refuses to start with SIRCL enabled when no relay rule is present.

model.quantization: fp8 attention and dense projections, MXFP4 routed experts (checkpoint fp8 quantization config with mxfp4 store dtype), bf16 DFlash draft
model.identity_note: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (MIT): 48 layers, 9 global-attention layers with 4 KV heads and 39 sliding-window layers with 8 KV heads and a 128-token window; Q/K head 192, V head 128; bundled five-layer DFlash draft (block size 8); vision and audio encoders. The pinned revision's dflash/config.json is valid JSON; earlier revisions need the launcher's corrected copy.

runtime.entrypoint: Pinned B12X/vLLM Python packages baked into a derived image; vLLM CLI through a login shell for CUDA compatibility initialization

serving.attention_backend: B12X for global and sliding-window target attention; packed Q/K-192, V-128 pages
serving.linear_backend: auto (the 3392-wide global-attention QKV slice at TP4 is not a multiple of 128, so linear kernels are chosen per layer)

cudagraph.note: C8 with five speculative tokens uses 48 query rows; the capture ceiling is 64. C16 admission can exceed that full-graph ceiling.

collectives.all_reduce: SIRCL custom mode: graph-only session on the primary rail pair for captured width-4096 collectives and the fused bidirectional prefill session on both rail pairs for eager [Q <= 8192, 4096] tensors; RoCEnante virtual diagonals over the hardware relay; PyNCCL over the four rails for everything else (custom all-reduce disabled)
collectives.sircl_environment: The SPARK_TP4_* and VLLM_SPARK_* assignments of the GLM-5.3 managed-mesh profile's rendered rank environment, plus VLLM_SPARK_TP4_MODE=custom and VLLM_SPARK_TP4_VOCAB_MODE=custom

serving.sizing_note: 20 GiB total target/draft KV allocation per rank; 2,189,381 logical tokens reported in the measured TP4 launch. The 16-sequence limit is admission capacity, not a throughput guarantee.

evidence.conditions: Four GB10 Sparks, TP4/DCP1, B12X target and draft, BF16 KV, DFlash5, V2 runner; llm-decode-bench v0.6.2 at 8K/128K and C1/C8 with 20-second decode windows.
evidence.result: Prefill approximately 4,005/3,288 tok/s at 8K/128K. C1 decode 54.54/47.20 tok/s. C8 repeats 162.30–198.97/141.82–148.50 tok/s. Short responses coherent; measured cells reported zero errors and no detected loops.
evidence.conclusion: Text serving and bounded performance checks pass on one site. Acceptance varies between runs; these results do not establish a universal decode speedup.
limitations: The image is built locally from pinned Python sources over a published native runtime; no prebuilt artifact is published.
Media input limits are configured, but image/video/audio inference has not been rechecked on this source composition.
No soak, accuracy suite, SparkCache composition or independent reproduction.

provenance.transport_implementation: SIRCL with RoCEnante virtual diagonals over the managed mesh; patched NVIDIA NCCL fallback
